title: Engine command catalogue, screen-to-agent protocol and the map-done rule
summary: Adds the one catalogue every skill and screen follows: the 14 Grillo commands with agent kind and release, the exact screen-to-agent messages, and the map-done rule; a test fails on a duplicate or misnamed command.
lessons_learned: Git Bash on Windows rewrites `origin/main:<path>` into a Windows path; set MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 before `git show origin/main:<path>` (not yet in shell-traps.md)
